cues.en: Hello, and welcome back.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Today, we're talking about another aspect of LightGBM call, and this one is called exclusive feature bundling, or EFB.
cues.zh: 今天談 LightGBM 另一個面向，互斥特徵綑綁，EFB。

cues.en: Let's have a look.
cues.zh: 來看看。

cues.en: So, from the LightGBM research paper, the large-scale data sets used in real applications are usually quite sparse.
cues.zh: LightGBM 論文指出，真實應用的大規模資料集，通常相當稀疏。

cues.en: So, what do they mean by that?
cues.zh: 什麼意思？

cues.en: Well, they mean columns which have lots of zeroes.
cues.zh: 就是有很多 0 的欄位。

cues.en: So, for example, here.
cues.zh: 例如這裡。

cues.en: Here, we've got a sample, where in our dataset, we've got an ID column for a transaction.
cues.zh: 範例資料有交易 ID 欄。

cues.en: And then, we've got was this transaction paid with cash, with credit card, debit card, gift card, or et cetera.
cues.zh: 再來是交易是否用現金、信用卡、簽帳金融卡、禮物卡等付款。

cues.en: So, as you can see, it's mostly zeroes with some values here and there.
cues.zh: 可以看到，多數是 0，少數位置有值。

cues.en: And that's what they mean that, in a lot of real-world applications, that is the case, there's lots of columns, and only some of them have values somewhere and a lot of the values are actually zeroes.
cues.zh: 意思是真實應用常如此，很多欄，但只有某些位置有值，大多是 0。

cues.en: And that causes a lot of inefficiency when working with gradient boosting, with decision trees, because all those columns have to be processed.
cues.zh: 梯度提升與決策樹處理時，所有欄都要運算，所以效率很差。

cues.en: So, what they're saying is that they've come up with a way, exclusive feature bundling, to put these columns, to combine sparse columns like that into one column.
cues.zh: 他們提出互斥特徵綑綁，將這種稀疏欄合成一欄。

cues.en: And in this case, we're taking these four columns, combining it into one.
cues.zh: 這裡將四欄合成一欄。

cues.en: Now, what's the caveat?
cues.zh: 有什麼條件？

cues.en: The caveat is that these have to be exclusive columns or almost exclusive, meaning that they take a non-zero value not at the same time.
cues.zh: 必須互斥或近乎互斥，意思是不會同時為非零值。

cues.en: So, for example, look at this row, it's all 0, except for one.
cues.zh: 例如這列，除了其中一格都是 0。

cues.en: Here, it's only one of them is a non-zero.
cues.zh: 這裡也只有一個非零。

cues.en: And then, we can bundle them.
cues.zh: 就能綑綁。

cues.en: Like, in this case, there's two values that are non-zero at the same time, and that's gonna cause a conflict.
cues.zh: 但這裡兩個值同時非零，會衝突。

cues.en: And they say in the research paper that a small number of conflicts, it's not very clear what percentage, but let's say a small percentage of conflicts,
cues.zh: 論文說少量衝突可接受，百分比不明確，但少量，

cues.en: maybe something like under 5% is...
cues.zh: 也許低於 5% 之類……

cues.en: Don't quote me on that, that's just a random guess, but a small percentage of conflicts is okay, is acceptable.
cues.zh: 別引用我這個數字，只是隨便猜。少量衝突可以接受。

cues.en: We'll have to deal with it and lose some accuracy.
cues.zh: 需要處理，也會失去部分精確程度。

cues.en: And as you'll see how we're going to go through this, so smallest number of conflicts can be okay.
cues.zh: 接著會看到，少量衝突沒關係。

cues.en: Another thing to keep in mind is that these columns, in this case, they're related to the transaction value.
cues.zh: 另一點，這些欄在例子裡都與交易金額有關。

cues.en: In reality, they don't have to be related.
cues.zh: 實際上不必相關。

cues.en: The goal is just to reduce space and reduce the number of columns.
cues.zh: 目標只是節省空間、減少欄數。

cues.en: The way you'll see the way we'll construct this new bundled feature, it's actually gonna treat them still independent.
cues.zh: 新綑綁特徵的建構方式，仍將它們獨立處理。

cues.en: You're just gonna store them in one column.
cues.zh: 只是存同一欄。

cues.en: But all of these, these four, will still be separable and independent of each other.
cues.zh: 這四個仍可區分，彼此獨立。

cues.en: And that's a huge, huge plus.
cues.zh: 是很大優點。

cues.en: So, it just basically looks through your data, looks for columns that can be bundled together, and then decides which ones to bundle together, regardless if they're related, like in this case, or not related.
cues.zh: 基本上掃描資料，找可綑綁的欄，決定綑哪些，不管像這裡有關聯，或沒關聯。

cues.en: So let's have a look how this works.
cues.zh: 看看怎麼運作。

cues.en: We're gonna take the first column and we're just going to put all the values.
cues.zh: 先取第一欄全部值。

cues.en: We're not gonna add any offset to this column, which is +0.
cues.zh: 不加偏移，也就是 +0。

cues.en: Don't worry about any offset, we'll talk about offset just now, and we'll just put the values from this column into the new column.
cues.zh: 別急，稍後談偏移，先將這欄數值放新欄。

cues.en: Then for the second column, what we'll do is we'll take the maximum of the previous column, meaning this one, Cash_Paid, we're taking the maximum there.
cues.zh: 第二欄，先取前一欄，也就是 Cash_Paid 的最大值。

cues.en: And let's say we know from this data, the maximum is 100.
cues.zh: 假設資料裡最大為 100。

cues.en: We add 1 to the 100, so just to make it a buffer.
cues.zh: 加 1，留緩衝。

cues.en: So, it's 100, so the maximum plus 1 makes it 101.
And then we add that value to all of the values here, and then we put them into the new feature.
cues.zh: 再將此偏移加到這裡數值，放進新特徵。

cues.en: And then, as you can see, we already lost this information.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這裡已失去一項資訊。

cues.en: So, LightGBM will make a smart decision on which of these to use, either this one or this one.
cues.zh: LightGBM 會聰明決定要用哪個，這個或這個。

cues.en: In this case, we're using the first one, the first one I came across.
cues.zh: 這裡先用第一個遇到的值。

cues.en: But it can look at things like which column is less sparse or which value is higher, or some other kind of like way to signify importance of the value.
cues.zh: 但也可看哪欄沒那麼稀疏、哪個值較大，或其他表示重要性的方式。

cues.en: And then, it'll pick one, but we will have to lose some information and we're okay with it if it happens rarely.
cues.zh: 再選一個，因此會損失資訊，偶爾發生可接受。

cues.en: So, if these conflicts don't happen often, as we'll see, like machine learning doesn't have to be perfect, as long as it gets the job done, and we are getting a lot...
cues.zh: 只要衝突不常出現，機器學習不必完美，能完成工作就好，而且會得到大量……

cues.en: We're gonna get a lot of efficiency using EFB.
cues.zh: EFB 會帶來很大效率。

cues.en: And it's okay if we lose some information along the way.
cues.zh: 所以過程少一些資訊，可以接受。

cues.en: Next one, we're going to take this column, and we're going to add the column max from here, which is 101.
cues.zh: 下一欄，加上這邊的欄最大值，這裡為 101。

cues.en: And we'll take the column max from here, which 101 plus 1 every time.
cues.zh: 取前面欄的最大值，每次都再加 1。

cues.en: So now, we're going to put that value into the final column.
cues.zh: 將數值放進最後一欄。

cues.en: And here, we're going to take this, again, take the maximums, which just for simplicity sake, we're saying that it's 100 every time.
cues.zh: 這裡再次取最大值，簡單起見，每次都假設 100。

cues.en: And we're going to put that into there.
cues.zh: 放進這裡。

cues.en: So now, what happens is you can see that these values are completely...
cues.zh: 現在可以看到，數值完全……

cues.en: So, that's our final result, and you can see that these values are completely separate, right?
cues.zh: 這是最後結果，值域完全分開，對吧？

cues.en: So, you always know.
cues.zh: 所以總知道來源。

cues.en: If something is under 100, then it's a Cash_Paid column.
cues.zh: 小於 100，來自 Cash_Paid。

cues.en: If something is between 100 and 1, 2, 200, and 201, then it's a...
cues.zh: 這裡講者將第二段範圍口述為約 100 到 201，

cues.en: It's from the second column, it came from credit card.
cues.zh: 來自第二欄信用卡。

cues.en: If it's between 202 and 302, then it's from this one.
And if it's 302 to 402, then it's from here.
So, even though they're all in the same column, they're kind of like just sharing this column, but they're completely independent.
cues.zh: 即使都在同欄，只是共用儲存位置，仍彼此獨立。

cues.en: That's why they don't really have to be related.
cues.zh: 所以不必相關。

cues.en: And so, the purpose of the offset, that's what the offset helps us with, is to ensure that when the features are bundled, the value ranges do not overlap.
cues.zh: 偏移的用途，就是確保綑綁後，各特徵值域不重疊。

cues.en: And because they do not overlap, we know exactly where they reside.
cues.zh: 不重疊，就知道來源區間。

cues.en: So basically, we've converted a data set before sparse columns into a data set with one.
cues.zh: 基本上，從四個稀疏欄，轉為一個欄。

cues.en: It's called a dense column without losing much, right?
cues.zh: 叫做稠密欄，沒有損失太多。

cues.en: We just lost one value here.
cues.zh: 只在這裡失去一個值。

cues.en: And so, if we move this to the left now over here, what's gonna happen?
cues.zh: 現在移到左邊，會發生什麼？

cues.en: Well, as we know, we've got...
cues.zh: 已經知道，

cues.en: LightGBM uses histogram-based tree splits.
cues.zh: LightGBM 使用直方圖分割樹。

cues.en: So, it's going to build a histogram.
cues.zh: 所以會建立直方圖。

cues.en: From all over the values that we have, it's gonna build a histogram.
cues.zh: 根據全部數值建立。

cues.en: And so here, we can see that the values from 0 to 100 are our...
cues.zh: 這裡 0 到 100 的值，

cues.en: They're related to the first column.
cues.zh: 對應第一欄。

cues.en: Those were cash purchases.
cues.zh: 那些是現金購買。

cues.en: These 100 to 200 were credit card purchases, I believe.
cues.zh: 100 到 200 應該是信用卡。

cues.en: And then 200 to 300 were debit card, and 300 to 400 were gift cards.
cues.zh: 200 到 300 是簽帳金融卡，300 到 400 是禮物卡。

cues.en: And it just so happens that the frequency of gift cards is the lowest, which kind of makes sense.
cues.zh: 剛好禮物卡頻率最低，很合理。

cues.en: People don't use gift cards as often.
cues.zh: 人們較少用禮物卡。

cues.en: Debit cards are a bit higher.
cues.zh: 簽帳金融卡稍高。

cues.en: Then, people prefer to use cash, and then they prefer to use credit cards.
cues.zh: 接著是現金，最常用信用卡。

cues.en: And by the way, this split between these values and these values, it just happens like this in our dataset.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，這些數值與這些數值的頻率差別，只是這份資料剛好如此。

cues.en: It could have been like quite uniform here.
cues.zh: 也可能很均勻。

cues.en: It doesn't matter.
cues.zh: 沒有影響。

cues.en: Like, it doesn't matter to us that these are much higher than these.
cues.zh: 不在意這些比那些高很多。

cues.en: It doesn't have to be that way because we just know that where the dataset gets split or where this column is separated is by the value,
cues.zh: 不必如此，因為資料集或這個欄的區段，是根據值，

cues.en: not by the frequency.
cues.zh: 不是頻率。

cues.en: The frequency can be...
cues.zh: 頻率可以……

cues.en: It's arbitrary, like here, it doesn't matter.
cues.zh: 是任意的，這裡不影響。

cues.en: But we know that the data set is split by value, value range, like this, well, our column that we create.
cues.zh: 知道新欄依值域分開就好。

cues.en: And so when we are doing the splits, when LightGBM is doing the splits, it's going to take...
cues.zh: 所以 LightGBM 分割時，會取……

cues.en: For example, it wants to split by credit card, right, by that second column.
cues.zh: 例如想依第二欄信用卡分割。

cues.en: It's going to just take this column and look at only values between 101 to 201.
cues.zh: 只看新欄的 101 到 201。

cues.en: It's only gonna look at those values.
cues.zh: 只看這些值。

cues.en: It's going to completely disregard the rest.
cues.zh: 其餘完全忽略。

cues.en: It'll create its own,
cues.zh: 形成自己的一段，

cues.en: like, separation like that.
cues.zh: 像這樣。

cues.en: And then, it will do the splits inside here.
cues.zh: 再於此範圍內切分。

cues.en: And so, these three splits can still be constructed for each feature separately, even though we only have one column.
cues.zh: 所以即使只有一欄，仍可對各特徵分別建樹的切分。

cues.en: So, there we go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: That's another way that LightGBM is accomplishing a huge leap forward in terms of efficiency.
cues.zh: 這是 LightGBM 另一個大幅提高效率的方法。

cues.en: And that is by combining sparse columns, which in like data sets that we use for learning machine learning might not be that frequent, but in real-world applications,
cues.zh: 合併稀疏欄，學習用資料集也許不常見，但真實應用

cues.en: they actually come about quite a lot, and you are likely to encounter them in your work as well.
cues.zh: 經常出現，工作時也很可能遇到。

cues.en: So, there you go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: That's what exclusive feature bundling is all about.
cues.zh: 這就是互斥特徵綑綁。

cues.en: And just remember that it combines sparse columns into a dense column with minimal loss of information or almost losslessly.
cues.zh: 記住，以最小、或幾乎零資訊損失，將稀疏欄合成稠密欄。

cues.en: And that really helps with the algorithms, with the modeling and the training process.
cues.zh: 大幅幫助演算法、建模與訓練流程。

cues.en: I look forward to seeing you back here next time.
cues.zh: 期待下次見。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受機器學習的樂趣吧。
